summary: Implemented SCH-06 timer jitter feature: added jitter_ms field to SchedulerConfig, prng field (std.Random.DefaultPrng) seeded from OS entropy to Scheduler struct, computePollDelayMs method for jittered poll interval calculation, and env-var support via BPM_SCHEDULER_JITTER_MS. Created 9 inline unit tests and 4 dedicated unit tests in sch06_timer_jitter_test.zig. All tests pass, zig build exits 0.

TC-SCH-06-04: computePollDelayMs never returns negative (clamps to 0)
TC-SCH-06-05: computePollDelayMs produces varied results with jitter enabled
TC-SCH-06-07: computePollDelayMs produces results in valid range across multiple calls
